newsitem.title: USA: D'Andrea joins GMS Group muni institutional sales.
newsitem.headline: D'Andrea joins GMS Group muni institutional sales.

text.p: Former JB Hanauer & Co senior vice president Louis D'Andrea joined The GMS Group Monday as a senior vice president in municipal institutional sales, John Feeney, GMS Group's president and chief executive officer said Wednesday.

"We just had a couple of lunches over the last three or four months, and it evolved into he thought he could be more successful here," Feeney said, adding that he has known D'Andrea for about 30 years.
"I've known Louie since high school, and neither one of us can remember what reunion we are going to," he said.
D'Andrea resigned from JB Hanauer on Monday. GMS is located in Livingston, N.J.
